title: Job details

fields.label: Work arrangement
fields.name: work_arrangement
fields.instructions: Remote roles are listed for anywhere in Canada.

fields.label: Closing date
fields.name: closing_date
fields.instructions: Optional. After this date the role leaves the Careers page and stops taking applications.

fields.label: City
fields.name: city
fields.instructions: Where the role is based, e.g. Dartmouth. Leave empty for a fully remote role.

fields.label: Pay from
fields.name: salary_min
fields.instructions: Optional pay range. Some provinces require a range in public job postings.

fields.label: Send applications to
fields.name: applications_email
fields.instructions: Applications for this role, with the resume attached, are emailed here.

description: Shown on the job's page and in its Google for Jobs data. The summary on the Careers page card is the Excerpt; the full description is the main editor.
